d: At just 15 years of age, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has produced an innings that has left the cricket world stunned. The young Indian batter smashed 204 runs off just 53 balls against UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup, hitting an astonishing 28 sixes. India A chased down 250 in only 14.2 overs, with Sooryavanshi reaching his century in 28 balls and his double century in 52. It was a record-breaking display of power-hitting, fearless batting and extraordinary timing. Rupha Ramani looks at the unbelievable Vaibhav Sooryavanshi innings that has everyone talking.
